name: button
title: Button
description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.

files.content:
---
import type { HTMLTag, Polymorphic } from "astro/types"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

import { buttonVariants, type ButtonVariantProps } from "./button-variants"

type Props<Tag extends HTMLTag = "button"> = Polymorphic<{ as: Tag }> &
  ButtonVariantProps

const {
  as: Tag = "href" in Astro.props ? "a" : "button",
  class: className,
  variant,
  size,
  ...props
} = Astro.props

const attributes: Record<string, unknown> = { ...props }
if (Tag === "button") attributes.type ??= "button"
---

<Tag
  data-slot="button"
  class={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size }), className)}
  {...attributes}
>
  <slot />
</Tag>

export { buttonVariants, type ButtonVariantProps } from "./button-variants"

export { default as Button } from "./button.astro"
